## Context
The README already has strong content and custom banners, but it should feel more like standout GitHub profile READMEs. Inspiration references were provided for profile-first visual hierarchy, compact highlight blocks, and richer social/metrics presentation.

## Decision
Adopt inspiration patterns without copying text: centered intro layout, social and profile badges, compact visual metrics section, and polished section rhythm while preserving existing personal brand and project facts.

## Steps
1. Extract structural patterns from inspiration links.
2. Keep existing core narrative and project proof points.
3. Add profile-style visual blocks (highlights, socials, stats).
4. Refine section order and spacing for better scanability.
5. Validate links and readability.

## Acceptance Criteria
- README shows clear inspiration from top-profile style patterns.
- Existing core content remains accurate and personalized.
- Visual blocks improve first impression without clutter.
- Links and badges render correctly on GitHub.
